description:
## **About**

Reservations are **still required** if you bring your own equipment. Tennis equipment can be picked up from the Island Market

Staff will be at the **Island Market** on the hour sharp to hand out equipment.

**Reservation is required** 

Must be 16 years or older to checkout equipment and a valid Driver's License or ID is required while equipment is in use.

As a courtesy, reply to the confirmation email to cancel.

**Please note we will wait 10 minutes before you forfeit your reservation and it will be cancelled.**
